text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Indian worker killed and 13 injured in gas leak at water desalination plant.
- Four investment groups to seek Kuwait Real Estate Bank shares at a public auction on Thursday. The state plans to sell 30 million shares of its stake in the bank.

- Kuwait's foreign minister meets Jordanian official who delivered a message from Jordan's prime minister. Ties between the two Arab states have been tense since 1990 when Jordan appeared to sympathise with Iraq after it invaded Kuwait.
- Kuwait and Saudi Arabia discuss oil operations in the border neutral zone.
